dataset.name: WTC 1 V8N inverse-calibrated cold core redistribution surrogate
dataset.scope: Post-impact cold redistribution over Floors 93-99 using NIST total core loads and maximum core-column axial DCR maps; no thermal, collapse, or Blender dynamics.
dataset.warning: This surrogate is calibrated to outputs of the NIST global model. Agreement is an emulation check, not independent validation of the NIST inputs or the real event. The equivalent membrane transfer length is an identifiable surrogate parameter, not a recovered ANSYS shell modulus.

model_hypotheses.baseline_load_prior: At each floor, pre-impact column load is proportional to the transcribed pre-impact maximum DCR times the V8B K=1 room-temperature capacity, then normalized to the published floor total.
model_hypotheses.removed_segments: Floor-specific Case B removed segments are inherited from V8B; their baseline load is redistributed only to surviving columns.
model_hypotheses.equivalent_membrane: Removed load spreads through an exponential distance kernel in column-bay units, biased by surviving column capacity. A global-mixing fraction represents the long-range component of the omitted equivalent slab membrane.
model_hypotheses.core_total_transfer_curve: The immediately-post-impact change in total core load is represented by a four-parameter logistic transition through the damage zone.
model_hypotheses.capacity_warning: V8B capacities reproduce the stated K=1 room-temperature method with historic WF proxies, but section transcription and NIST implementation differences remain possible.

spatial_generalization.method: declared checkerboard holdout before parameter search

acceptance_gates.physical_interpretation: Passing only validates this reduced surrogate as an emulator of the selected NIST cold outputs.

provenance.transcription_status: manual numeric transcription from complete rendered pages; deterministic validation checks are required

spatial_calibration.method: declared checkerboard holdout before parameter search

summary.gate_explanation: Au moins un seuil hors echantillon echoue; le surrogate ne doit pas etre propage vers la thermique.
summary.gate_decision: **NON VALIDE.** La redistribution interne inverse reste insuffisamment predictive. La prochaine iteration doit enrichir sa topologie ou retrouver des entrees mecaniques supplementaires avant toute thermique.
summary.report_conclusion: La V8N ne generalise pas suffisamment les sorties froides NIST laissees hors calibration. Une concordance sur les points ajustes ne peut donc pas reparer le chemin de charge manquant des V8L/V8M.
summary.interpretation: The fitted parameters emulate selected NIST cold outputs and are not event probabilities, recovered ANSYS material properties, independent validation, or demolition evidence.
